title: Residential Intrusion Mitigation System
summary: A formal security consulting audit of a suburban residence that maintained site control during repeated unauthorized entry attempts using one junior on-site manager, visual occupancy simulation, layered household security systems, and a local response partner.
visualDirection: Vintage mid-century institutional case-study film. Use aged cream report paper, charcoal linework, restrained brick-red accents, generous margins, subtle projector texture, and completely serious consulting-document composition. Each slide has one clear visual proposition and no more than three primary visual elements.

opening.instruction: Reuse the approved LLFC series opening unchanged.

characters.name: Kevin
characters.visualDescription: An eight-year-old white boy with fair skin, short tousled blond hair, a small build, an alert expression, and practical winter clothing built around a deep red knit sweater. Keep his age, hair, facial proportions, and red sweater consistent whenever visible.

characters.name: Harry
characters.visualDescription: A short, stocky middle-aged white man with a round weathered face, dark stubble, a dark knitted cap, and a heavy black winter coat. He is the more compact of the two unauthorized visitors.

characters.name: Marv
characters.visualDescription: A very tall, thin middle-aged white man with a long narrow face, unruly dark curly hair, a dark knitted cap, and a worn long brown winter coat. He is visibly taller than Harry.

characters.name: Old Man Marley
characters.visualDescription: A tall elderly white man with swept-back white hair, a short white beard, a grave but calm expression, a dark overcoat, winter gloves, and a broad snow shovel.

characters.name: Kate
characters.visualDescription: A white woman in her late thirties with shoulder-length auburn hair, a worried but capable expression, and a tailored dark winter coat. She represents off-site senior management and does not appear in the planned illustration scenes.

sentences: Visual occupancy simulation used cardboard personnel, a model train, music, and lighting.
The simulated guests moved continuously, so the residence appeared active from the street.
The system required no additional payroll.

A single route passes through three clear defense zones: a glassy ice-covered exterior stair, a glowing overheated brass front doorknob, and two full paint containers suspended above the main staircase on ropes. Vintage government engineering-review illustration, aged cream report paper, precise charcoal lines, restrained brick-red hazard accents, ample negative space, subtle projector texture, no people, lettering, numbers, watermarks, or brand marks.
sentences: The facility used several independent layers of intrusion mitigation.
